price_scope: All5lines including MOQ extras; excludes carrier/protoboard, local assembly, wires/headers, pullups, power/protection, all other subsystems and freight. A9CNY shipping-coupon label is not actual Qingyuan freight.
assembly_scope: These are loose through-hole parts, not preassembled modules. No user SMT soldering. A mechanical carrier and socket/cap assembly or actual vendor preweld service still required; do not silently expand user ability beyond headers/wires.

EEPROM_contract.socket: 8脚2.54mm节距、7.62mm排距直插IC座，1只；具体座SKU/价待冻结
EEPROM_contract.local_decoupling: 100nF X7R 直插电容1只，直接跨8/4脚；具体SKU/价待冻结
driver_requirements: 64字节边界拆分，跨页写会回卷覆盖
不能把32KiB当成任意时长音频存储；按原产品用途和格式验收

power_contract.original_topology: 5V_IN -> F1 PTC -> Q1 reverse-polarity protection -> TPS2553 active-high limiter ->5V_PERIPH; EN=3V3_IO. AP2112K U18 derives3V3_PERIPH separately. Preserve independent rail identities and off-state discharge/isolators.
power_contract.U17: TPS2553DBVR C55266, NOT a regulator and NOT a generic3A supply
power_contract.design_interpretation: About1.00A minimum threshold, not1.5A or3A guaranteed for the original resistor setting. PTC, thermal, input droop and connector limits are additional constraints, not removed by this calculation.
power_contract.amplifier_power_case: If R12U delivers its labelled2x2W total4W, even ideal5V conversion needs>=0.8A before speaker-amplifier losses and all other loads. Full screen/DAC/logic peak currents remain unknown; no actual overload claim or complete load budget accepted.
power_contract.proposal_only: Do not silently add speaker-amplifier current to the original peripheral branch or enlarge R67/F1 thresholds. Compare a separately protected5V speaker branch or externally powered active speaker; exact supply/protection/harness/price and power-off behaviour must close first.

not_accepted_modules.primary_limit: 5V isolated supply output max150mA; manufacturer requires controller and module sides not shorted
not_accepted_modules.decision: Not a drop-in TCA9517/shared-common-ground peripheral replacement. Do not use its150mA output to power the screen/DAC branch.

not_accepted_modules.primary_warning: Manufacturer says power passes through the breakout; it is a bus buffer, not a power isolator. QT cables not included.
not_accepted_modules.decision: Do not connect the two original independent3.3V rails to the board as-is. Pullup/EN/supply-off analysis and actual pin/schematic evidence still required; no replacement accepted.
